# Central pin file for CI-installed tools.
# Consumed via:  uv pip install --constraint=.github/workflows/constraints.txt ...
#
# Adding a tool here pins its version across every CI job that uses
# `--constraint=` against this file. Keep entries narrow and justified.

# Pins the Home Assistant release the suite runs against (the plugin pins HA
# exactly).  0.13.325 -> HA 2026.4.4, verified green locally: 4950 passed,
# 0 errors.  The old 0.13.316 pin (HA 2026.2.3) existed to keep the Python
# 3.13 leg installable; that leg is gone — HA 2026.4+ and every plugin
# release from 0.13.317 on require Python 3.14.
#
# Moving further is blocked, not forgotten: from HA 2026.5.0 on, the
# `verify_cleanup` fixture fails five to seven tests that build a MagicMock
# `hass` with a hand-rolled `async_create_task` and never cancel what they
# start — SberBridge._delayed_confirm survives the test (test_bridge.py,
# test_impulse_gate_flows.py, test_gate_auto_close.py,
# test_integration_flows.py).  Real HA tracks those tasks, so this is test
# hygiene, not a bridge leak.  Fix those fixtures first, then this pin can
# move to 0.13.357 (HA 2026.8.3 — what users report issues on).  HA 2026.9
# additionally needs `dr.async_get(hass).devices.values()` in
# test_websocket_full_stack.py replaced (mapping access is now reported as
# deprecated) and a syrupy 5 -> 6 snapshot migration.
pytest-homeassistant-custom-component==0.13.325

# syrupy 5.x writes/reads __snapshots__/ (our committed location). syrupy 6.x
# changes serializer behaviour; lock to 5.x until that migration is done.
syrupy>=5.0,<6.0

# ruff: без пина CI тянет последнюю версию, и новое правило в свежем релизе
# красит Lint на всех открытых PR (так 0.16.1 уронила main новым LOG004).
# Обновляем осознанно, вместе с фиксами найденных нарушений.
ruff==0.16.1
